name: @xpayr/mcp-server
title: XPayr Non-Custodial Crypto Payment Gateway & AI Agent Commerce MCP Server
description: Official 21-tool Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for XPayr (https://xpayr.com) enabling AI agents, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code to create multi-chain crypto payment links, verify on-chain transactions across EVM/TRON/Solana/Arc, manage HMAC webhooks, and execute policy-controlled AI agent payments.

tools.name: xpayr_health_check
tools.title: API Gateway Health Check
tools.description: Check XPayr Gateway API v1 operational health, version, and server timestamp.

tools.name: xpayr_create_payment_session
tools.title: Create Crypto Payment Session (Dual Checkout)
tools.description: Create a non-custodial crypto payment session supporting Web3 1-Click Pay, Direct Exchange QR Transfer, Multi-Chain Links, 1-Year Reusable Links, and Automated HTML Invoice Email Delivery.

params.name: currency
params.description: Token symbol (USDT, USDC, SOL, TRX, BNB, ETH, MATIC).

params.name: network
params.description: Network key (tron-mainnet, solana-mainnet, bsc-mainnet, base-mainnet, arc-mainnet).

params.name: is_multi_chain
params.description: Allow buyer to dynamically select any active network and token at checkout.

params.name: is_reusable
params.description: Keep link active for 1 year for repeat payments.

params.name: send_invoice_email
params.description: Dispatch branded HTML invoice email to customer_email.

tools.name: xpayr_get_payment_session
tools.title: Get Payment Session Details
tools.description: Retrieve full details, metadata, settlement split amounts, checkout mode, and on-chain transaction hash for a payment session.

tools.name: xpayr_list_payment_sessions
tools.title: List Merchant Payment Sessions
tools.description: List merchant crypto payment sessions with filtering by status, currency, network, and pagination.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status (pending, completed, expired, failed).

tools.name: xpayr_get_public_payment_status
tools.title: Poll Public On-Chain Payment Status
tools.description: Poll real-time public checkout status, on-chain tx_hash, sender wallet address, block confirmations, and paid_at timestamp without an API key.

tools.name: xpayr_apply_payment_coupon
tools.title: Apply Checkout Discount Coupon
tools.description: Validate and apply a merchant promotional discount coupon code to an active pending payment session.

tools.name: xpayr_get_merchant_profile
tools.title: Get Merchant Profile & Settlement Wallet
tools.description: Retrieve authenticated merchant profile, settlement wallet address, commission rate in basis points (50 bps = 0.5%), and active API keys.

tools.name: xpayr_get_merchant_balance
tools.title: Get Multi-Chain Settlement Volume & Balance
tools.description: Query confirmed non-custodial settlement volume, transaction counts, and platform fees grouped by currency and blockchain network.

tools.name: xpayr_get_supported_networks
tools.title: List Supported Networks, Chains & Tokens
tools.description: List all active EVM, TRON, Solana, and Arc Mainnet/Testnet blockchain networks, chain IDs, RPC endpoints, splitter contracts, and supported tokens.

tools.name: xpayr_get_webhook_config
tools.title: Get Webhook Configuration & Events
tools.description: Inspect the merchant webhook callback URL, masked HMAC-SHA256 signing secret, and subscribed payment lifecycle events.

tools.name: xpayr_set_webhook_endpoint
tools.title: Configure HTTPS Webhook Endpoint
tools.description: Configure or update the merchant HTTPS webhook receiver URL and generate a fresh 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 signing secret.

tools.name: xpayr_send_test_webhook
tools.title: Dispatch Signed Test Webhook Event
tools.description: Send a signed test.webhook payload with HMAC-SHA256 headers to verify merchant webhook signature verification.

tools.name: xpayr_create_ai_agent
tools.title: Create Policy-Controlled AI Commerce Agent
tools.description: Provision a new merchant-managed AI commerce agent identity with scoped credentials and programmable spending guardrails.

params.name: description
params.example: Pays API and compute invoices under $50 automatically.

tools.name: xpayr_list_ai_agents
tools.title: List Merchant AI Commerce Agents
tools.description: List all AI commerce agents managed by the merchant along with their status, assigned wallets, and spending policies.

tools.name: xpayr_update_ai_agent_policy
tools.title: Update AI Agent Spending Guardrails
tools.description: Configure spending policy guardrails for an AI agent (max per-tx USD, daily cap, auto-approve threshold, allowed chains/tokens).

tools.name: xpayr_submit_agent_payment_intent
tools.title: Submit Autonomous AI Agent Payment Intent
tools.description: Submit an autonomous AI agent payment intent evaluated in real time against merchant policy rules (approved, pending_approval, rejected).

tools.name: xpayr_list_agent_payment_intents
tools.title: List AI Agent Payment Intents & Audit Logs
tools.description: List AI agent payment intents, policy evaluation decisions, and audit trail records for the merchant.

tools.name: xpayr_bridge_agent_intent_to_checkout
tools.title: Bridge Approved Agent Intent to Checkout Session
tools.description: Bridge an approved AI agent payment intent into a live executable XPayr payment session with hosted checkout URL and on-chain verification.

tools.name: xpayr_approve_agent_intent
tools.title: Approve Pending AI Agent Intent (Human-in-the-Loop)
tools.description: Approve a pending AI agent payment intent from the merchant approval queue and bridge it to checkout.

tools.name: xpayr_reject_agent_intent
tools.title: Reject Pending AI Agent Intent
tools.description: Reject a pending AI agent payment intent in the merchant approval queue with an audit reason.

tools.name: xpayr_calculate_gateway_fee_and_split
tools.title: 0.5% Gateway Fee Split & Exchange Tolerance Calculator
tools.description: Deterministically calculate XPayr flat 0.5% (50 bps) gateway fee split, net merchant wallet settlement, 1% (max $0.50) exchange withdrawal tolerance, and savings vs BitPay, Coinbase Commerce, and Stripe.

params.name: amount
params.description: Transaction or monthly volume amount in USD/USDT.
